chinese: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
pinyin: jù shuō tā bà ba zài wài guó qù shì le.
english: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

pinyin: wǒ shì hǎo rén.
english: I'm a nice guy.

chinese: 你什么时候看那部电影？
pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hou kàn nà bù diàn yǐng?
english: When did you see the film?

chinese: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
pinyin: tā men de hé tong zài zhè ge yuè dǐ dào qī.
english: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

chinese: 你觉得明天会有个好天气吗？
pinyin: nǐ jué de míng tiān huì yǒu gè hǎo tiān qì ma?
english: Do you think we'll have good weather tomorrow?
I wish I knew.

pinyin: tā shì gè fēi cháng hǎo de lǎo shī.
english: She is a very good teacher.

pinyin: nǐ men zěn me gǎo de?
english: What's the matter with you people?

pinyin: tā shì ge hǎo pí qi de rén.
english: He is a pleasant person.

pinyin: nǐ xiǎng kàn fáng zi ma?
english: Do you want to see the house?

pinyin: wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù hǎo.
english: I'm not well at all.

chinese: 我想看一下里面有什么。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn yī xià lǐ miàn yǒu shén me.
english: I want to see what there is inside.

pinyin: wǒ men yǐ jīng xiǎng hǎo le.
english: We've already decided.

pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me lái le rì běn?
english: Why did you come to Japan?

pinyin: jīn tiān diàn shì yǒu shén me hǎo jié mù?
english: Are there any good programs on TV today?

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng shāng hài nǐ.
english: I don't want to hurt you.

pinyin: gěi nǐ jiě shì zhè wèi shén me xíng bu tōng yào huā hěn duō shí jiān.
english: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.

chinese: 他们认为自己是幸运的。
pinyin: tā men rèn wéi zì jǐ shì xìng yùn de.
english: They consider themselves fortunate.
He's a good man.

chinese: 你知道怎么操作电脑吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhī dào zěn me cāo zuò diàn nǎo ma?
english: Do you know how to operate a computer?

chinese: 你做了一项完美的工作。
pinyin: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò.
english: You've done a perfect job.

chinese: 我们那时寻找的就是他。
pinyin: wǒ men nà shí xún zhǎo de jiù shì tā.
english: He is the one we were looking for.

chinese: 我家小的不喜欢去看牙。
pinyin: wǒ jiā xiǎo de bù xǐ huan qù kàn yá.
english: My child dislikes the dentist.

chinese: 有什么事是我该做的吗？
pinyin: yǒu shén me shì shì wǒ gāi zuò de ma?
english: Is there anything I must do?

english: Truth is, I don't like him.

chinese: 您能教我下国际象棋吗？
pinyin: nín néng jiāo wǒ xià guó jì xiàng qí ma?
english: Can you teach me to play chess?

pinyin: nǐ de mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn le.
english: Your dreams have come true.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ mào le duō dà de fēng xiǎn.
english: I know what you've risked.

chinese: 我父亲是一名外科专家。
pinyin: wǒ fù qin shì yī míng wài kē zhuān jiā.
english: My father is an expert surgeon.

chinese: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yī gè tí shì ma?
english: Would you give me a hint?

english: Do you believe that he is telling the truth?

pinyin: tā zhù zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi de mǒu ge dì fang.
english: He lives somewhere around the park.

english: I don't know how I should do it.

pinyin: gāi yóu nǐ lái jué dìng wǒ men qù bù qù nà r.

english: I stayed at home.

pinyin: bù shì zhǐ yǒu nǐ yǒu zhè shān mén de yào shi ma?
english: Aren't you the only one who has a key to this door?

english: I bumped my head against the door and got a lump.

english: Did you notice anything strange?

english: I want to stay here longer.

pinyin: tā zhuā zhù le wǒ de shǒu bì.

english: He painted his bicycle red.

pinyin: tā bǎ qián sāi dào wǒ de kǒu dài lǐ.

english: I don't like novels without heroes.

english: Have you ever shot a gun?

english: His parents expect too much of him.

english: I've had black rice congee thrice in one day!

english: It's now your turn.

pinyin: tā bèi tā de xiào róng xī yǐn zhù le.
english: He was attracted by her smile.

english: I knew it wasn't an accident.

english: What is that big building in front of us?

english: I didn't mean to offend anyone.

pinyin: wǒ gàn zhè yì háng yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ le.
english: I've been in this business a long time.

pinyin: wǒ cái shì nà ge xiǎng hé nǐ zài yī qǐ de rén!
english: I'm the one who wants to be with you.

english: Our house was robbed while we were away.

english: Why wouldn't you listen to his advice?

english: Don't pry into the affairs of others.

pinyin: hé nǐ de chē bǐ qǐ lái, wǒ de chē hěn xiǎo.
english: Compared to yours, my car is small.

english: The man and his wife helped each other.

english: Do you think I'm qualified for that job?

english: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.

english: For once in my life I'm doing a good deed... And it is useless.

english: I can't eat any more.

english: I have a free spirit.

pinyin: sǐ wáng shì wéi yī kě néng de jiě tuō ma?
english: Is death the only way to liberation?

pinyin: wǒ bù néng rěn shòu tā de ào màn.
english: I can't stand his arrogance.

chinese: 我想和你讨论一些事情。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ tǎo lùn yī xiē shì qing.
english: I'd like to discuss something with you.

english: What do you think of this?

pinyin: wǒ fā shì zài yě bù hé tā shuō huà le.
english: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.

english: His boyfriend is an idiot.

english: When does your new store open?

english: He has no sense of right and wrong.

pinyin: wǒ men měi tiān zǎo shang dào gōng yuán lǐ liù gǒu.
english: Every morning we take the dog for a walk in the park.

pinyin: nǐ bù gāi wán nòng tā de gǎn qíng.
english: You should not trifle with his feelings.

pinyin: nà jiā huo shì shéi?
english: Who's that guy?

english: My grandfather was a policeman.
